## Schedule I 0.4.7 support

- Supports the released Special Customers update on Mono (`alternate`) and IL2CPP (`public`). Dialogue, sleep/time, player data, NPC movement, clothing, and character creation now use the 0.4.7 native APIs. Tracks [#305](https://github.com/ifBars/S1API/issues/305).
- Restores avatar mugshots, accessory icons, appearance getters, and the NPC appearance workbench through the new avatar pipeline. Captures reset and settle the render rig between subjects; reloaded NPCs retain their portraits.

## Custom NPCs, contacts, and persistence

- Restores plain NPC construction and initializes customer, dealer, and supplier data before native startup and prefab configuration. Dealer conversion removes the replaced component instead of registering the same NPC twice. See [#311](https://github.com/ifBars/S1API/pull/311), [#317](https://github.com/ifBars/S1API/pull/317), [#334](https://github.com/ifBars/S1API/pull/334), and [#359](https://github.com/ifBars/S1API/pull/359).
- Fixes sender information, duplicate Messages entries, and contact registration after network spawn and save reload. Messages sent during load completion survive delayed spawn and ordinary saving. See [#322](https://github.com/ifBars/S1API/pull/322), [#325](https://github.com/ifBars/S1API/pull/325), [#328](https://github.com/ifBars/S1API/pull/328), and [#329](https://github.com/ifBars/S1API/pull/329).
- Retains load-completion listeners across returns to the menu without duplicate callbacks. See [#323](https://github.com/ifBars/S1API/pull/323).
- Scene-object indexing and cached ordinary assembly discovery reduce repeated custom NPC lookup work. A repeatable total loading-time improvement has not been established. See [#354](https://github.com/ifBars/S1API/pull/354) and [#355](https://github.com/ifBars/S1API/pull/355).

## Phone apps, icons, and appearance

- Restores discovery of mods built against older S1API versions, including Mods App. Phone app initialization reports progress and useful failures while allowing other apps to initialize. See [#333](https://github.com/ifBars/S1API/pull/333) and [#346](https://github.com/ifBars/S1API/pull/346).
- Restores item icon capture after the preview-layer rename and honors requested icon sizes. Packaging icon patches select the current native signatures, including the runtime generator introduced in f11. See [#336](https://github.com/ifBars/S1API/pull/336), [#345](https://github.com/ifBars/S1API/pull/345), and [#353](https://github.com/ifBars/S1API/pull/353).
- Custom accessories retain their own avatar objects, textures, and tints. Workbench preview poses animate correctly, and portrait rebound retains its owned rig's hip position. See [#332](https://github.com/ifBars/S1API/pull/332) and [#358](https://github.com/ifBars/S1API/pull/358).
- Fixes the Gamepad settings hang when a loading dock changes its vehicle without a registered listener. See [#316](https://github.com/ifBars/S1API/pull/316).

## Compatibility and validation

Existing managed public contracts, save identifiers, and network formats are retained. The previously documented native `PhoneApp.Exit` parameter migration remains represented by the managed compatibility type. Use this release with Schedule I 0.4.7; compatibility with the previous game release is not claimed.

Final 0.4.7f12 validation covered clean Mono/IL2CPP builds, 792 Mono and 766 IL2CPP contract tests, and four custom NPC roles over two save loads per runtime. Portraits, customer data, and single-component registration passed. Earlier beta validation also covered local host/client gameplay and reload/rejoin; final-release S1API multiplayer and real Steam transport were not retested in this pass. A native IL2CPP vehicle exception was observed during application shutdown after the successful probe.
